html:
Unique Research · Insight · October 19, 2022 · Full rewrite — not a stub

Post-pandemic CBEC boom meets demand fatigue in the West — sellers turn to SEA as a blue ocean vs mature US/EU stacks. SEA 11 countries, 683M people (8.58% world); urban >50%; median age 30.2; ID 278M / PH 112M lead. IMF: VN/PH/ID/MY real GDP growth to outpace world/China/US in 2023–24; ADB SEA 2022 ~5%. H1’22 ID GDP $653B (+5.44%). Internet: +40M users in ’21 → 440M; SG/MY penetration 92%/89.6%; online shoppers 350M (+30M). Digital economy on path to $1T.

Playbook: (1) brand power to escape homogenization; (2) digital services for durable ops; (3) last-mile logistics still the bottleneck; (4) digital payments + BNPL rising. Culture: Buddhism (TH) vs world’s largest Muslim population (ID); archipelago geography fragments logistics. Charts in CN images — attach on ingest.

— END —
